payload.description_html: Kapes bentoni Spencer & Storrs, 2002, skeleton reconstruction, based on specimen BRSUG 29950-13, in: A, lateral; B, dorsal view. Missing parts of the skeleton (in lighter grey) reconstructed based on the skeleton reconstruction of Procolophon trigoniceps Owen, 1876 by deBraga (2003). Scale bar represents 10 mm.
